description: Recently changed visa rules — what changed, for which passport/destination pair, on what date, and from which official source. STATUS: Orizn's change feed is currently OFF and this tool returns {status:"unavailable", changes: []}. It was shut down because it was publishing internally-detected inconsistencies between two Orizn tables as if they were official policy changes. An empty answer here therefore means "Orizn has no verified change data", NEVER "nothing changed" — do not tell the user rules are stable, tell them to check the destination's official immigration source, and use check_visa_requirement for the current rule with its verification date. When the feed comes back, only entries carrying a named source and a date are returned; unverified entries are dropped rather than shown.

destination.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 destination code to filter on (e.g. 'JPN').

limit.description: Maximum number of changes to return (1-200, default 50).

passport.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 passport code to filter on (e.g. 'FRA').

since.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — only changes detected on or after this date.

name: get_recent_changes
